current.text: He re-signed with Golden State for 2 years and 14 million USD.
Kristaps Porzingis is out, so Horford is projected to start at center. The projected starters are Curry, Podziemski, Lendeborg, Green and Horford.
When Porzingis is healthy, he is expected to be the backup center.
He is expected to play about 60 games because he will sit back-to-backs.
The Warriors have 15 back-to-backs, tied for second most in the league.
One expert says to ignore him in most fantasy leagues.
The Warriors are reportedly treating this season as a gap year and are worried about lottery odds.
The Warriors may rest veterans like him, and experts expect Warriors players to fade as the season goes on.
The Warriors schedule is good for fantasy playoffs that end on March 28.

note: Yahoo ranks him 205 and ESPN ranks him 199, both at 0 USD, and he went for 1 USD in our auction last season. That puts him outside our 144 drafted players, so do not bid on him. Watch him on waivers while he starts at center with Porzingis out, but he skips every back-to-back on a team with 15 of them, and his FG% has been around 42% for two seasons. The first weeks should show if his minutes climb back above last season's 21.6 and how long Porzingis stays out.
